# Synthetic fixture, not benchmark evidence

Hand-authored deterministic values. No captured traffic or personal measurements.
All four addresses are RFC 5737 documentation addresses, not usable resolvers.
Two eligible candidates, one dead candidate, one untested candidate; two historical
runs with three cached and three uncached samples per eligible candidate.
The reduced sample count deliberately differs from a real 50+50 benchmark.

Use only for browsing and offline tests. Do not start discovery or measurement
against this fixture: measurement also adds real public reference resolvers.
Copy it to a disposable directory before launching the UI; do not modify this
source fixture. See the repository README for commands.
